summary.name: Aurora Gradients / Glassmorphism
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: frosted panels sit over slow aurora bands, diffuse color fields, or mesh gradients with two to four main colors at stable brightness. Panels use fine borders, highlights, and soft shadows. Refraction or dispersion is optional. Foreground text stays sharp.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: ambient hero screens and calm brand moments. Explicit: hybrid use when panels must demonstrate product behavior or present data clearly. Inferred: premium launch pages, wellness, finance, or energy dashboards. Other uses are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Explicit: avoid banding, shimmering edges, excessive blur, and backgrounds that compete with reading. Background blur alone is not refraction. Opaque contrast checks do not validate translucent panels, highlights, or shadows, so recheck composited frames. Not a synonym for Liquid Glass.
summary.palette: Authored suggestion, used only when no approved palette is supplied: background #142535, foreground #F2F6F4, accents #7FAAD0 blue, #9B87C3 violet, #65AAA5 teal. Accents form the aurora; background and foreground are neutral layout roles. Gradient optional, LAB space, background only. Task colors override these values. Foreground on background measures 14.314:1; background text on accents measures 6.363, 4.939, and 5.83 respectively.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: aurora moves slowly while panel movement stays precise. Explicit: video drives all state from composition time, and live hover, scroll, or pointer input belongs only to interactive delivery. Optional motion references are screened per scene and none is required. Combination guidance warns against bouncy springs.
summary.audio: Unspecified: the style assigns no music genre, tempo, instrument, voice, or mandatory audio layer. Inferred: restrained ambience, silence, or quiet music suits slow aurora motion. Any speech must stay intelligible over music. Supplied or authorized audio takes priority.
summary.assetRequirements: Unspecified: no specific asset list, exact copy, or font set is supplied. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Randomness must be seeded, and stateful simulations cached. Required tools are browser-native: WebGL, GLSL, HTML/CSS, and optionally SVG. Native 3D engines are not required.
summary.combinations: Explicit: style-095 adds interface motion, with component states on frosted panels and #7FAAD0 for active states while the aurora stays slow. Explicit: style-097 adds data display, with simple charts inside cards, one accent per series, and no gradient-filled marks. Explicit: place no data on the moving aurora.
summary.productionApproach: Explicit: HyperFrames is the primary pipeline, using data-composition-id, a paused GSAP timeline registered in window.__timelines, check, snapshot, and render. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames cannot meet a constraint, and the reason must be recorded. Visuals come from a full-screen WebGL/GLSL aurora, CSS backdrop-filter panels, and DOM text.
